All Price Information

  • Pro：$29.99

Application Description

What comes back is ready to use. Not a suggestion — a deck, a spreadsheet, a chart, a document, a design or a website you can open right away. Say what you need done; it runs the rest. WHAT IT CAN DO Documents & office ・Documents — drop in contracts, reports or specs and get a clause-by-clause comparison ・Slides — conclusions laid out as pages you can present, .pptx ready to download ・Spreadsheets — .xlsx with the formulas and formatting intact Analysis & research ・Data & charts — align, clean and plot tables that don't agree with each other ・Deep research — cross-checked across rounds, every key number traceable to its source ・Wide research — many subjects, many dimensions, side by side Visual & design ・Generate images — people, scenes, illustrations, avatars; reference images and revisions ・Diagrams — architecture, flow and sequence diagrams you can open and read ・Design — posters, covers and promo art, finished and usable Build & ship ・Websites — a page that opens on a double-click and works on a phone ・Apps — a single .html file; data stays local and exports for backup ・Games — an actual playable round, keyboard and touch Education & learning ・Explain a problem — what it tests, where people slip, plus one more like it MEETINGS ・Cantonese, Mandarin and English: record or upload, live transcription and translation ・Minutes with decisions, action items and open questions ・Up to 5 hours per recording, 200MB uploads HOW BILLING WORKS ・Start free ・A subscription gives you a monthly pool of credits; each task draws by how much compute it takes ・Credits reset monthly and don't roll over ・Transcription minutes are counted separately from task credits The same account syncs with www.notteka.com — start on your phone, pick it up on a computer. —— Subscription ・Notteka is an auto-renewing subscription at US$9.99/month; prices in other regions are shown on the purchase screen and confirmed before you buy ・Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase ・It renews automatically within 24 hours before the end of the current period unless auto-renew is turned off before then ・Renewal is charged at the same price as the current period ・Manage or cancel in Settings › Apple ID › Subscriptions; cancellation takes effect at the end of the current period Terms of Use: https://www.notteka.com/en/terms Privacy Policy: https://www.notteka.com/en/privacy

entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：$0.99 → Free [Free ~ $2.99]）

All Price Information

Price：Free

In-App Purchases

  • All Classes Unlocked：$9.99

Application Description

Survive in endless dungeons by connecting blocks to attack, defend, and heal. Dungeon Tracer is a roguelike puzzle RPG that combines strategic turn-based combat with dungeon exploration. Connect identical blocks to unleash powerful sword attacks, shield defenses, and life-saving potions. Your decisions each turn shape the outcome of battles and your survival. ■ Recommended for - Players who enjoy puzzle RPGs and roguelikes - Fans of turn-based strategy combat - Those seeking offline dungeon adventures - Gamers who love crafting new builds and strategies through replay ■ Core Gameplay - Connect blocks to attack, defend, and heal - Every turn's choice impacts your strategy - Combo effects grow stronger with longer connections - Embrace the roguelike challenge where death means starting anew - Develop survival strategies in ever-changing scenarios ■ In-Depth Strategic Combat Experience the blend of intuitive block connection puzzles and the tactical depth of roguelike RPGs. Your play style varies with block placements, enemy types, skill selections, and item combinations. ■ 10 Classes and 10 Races Each class features unique skills and traits. Combine these with racial traits for diverse builds. Experiment to find your ideal strategy. ■ Diverse Skills and Builds Mix over 40 active skills and growth elements to create your unique combat style. Each skill and item choice leads to different outcomes. ■ Special Monsters and Block Debuffs Face 43 unique monsters, including liches, avengers, kamikazes, and assassins. Block debuffs like freeze, fire, poison, and lock can turn the tide of battle. Simply connecting blocks won't guarantee victory. ■ Fair Roguelike Challenge A seed-based deterministic random system ensures consistent results in each run. Enjoy a challenge where strategy and judgment outweigh luck. ■ More Fun with Repeated Growth Skill choices evolve with each level-up Builds focus on upgrades and items Dungeons reconfigure with each playthrough A structure where a single mistake heightens the tension ■ Global Leaderboard Compete with players worldwide. Test your skills against global rankings and showcase your best scores. ■ 4 Difficulty Levels Choose from Easy, Normal, Hard, and Very Hard Enjoyable challenges for both newcomers and veterans. ■ Premium Offline RPG - No ads - No in-app purchases - Enjoy offline play Once purchased, access all content fully. ■ Support for Multiple Languages and Cloud Save Supports 22 languages, ensuring you can continue your adventure seamlessly across devices. Endless dungeons await, filled with powerful monsters and strategic choices. How long can you survive? Experience the depth of puzzle roguelike RPGs in Dungeon Tracer today!

Application Description

Overwinter Survival is a card-based survival game in which you are stranded on the glaciers of Greenland. The cold and loneliness ensnare you after your plane breaks down for an unknown reason, leaving you crashed on Greenland's glaciers and seeking shelter at a nearby cabin. Now you must hunt, craft tools and items, and keep your stove fueled to survive in the cold. In Overwinter Survival, you must use the cards you're dealt to stay alive. You can only use one card per round. With Lady Luck at the helm, no two journeys will be the same. Fish in the glaciers, hunt with your spear and craft an axe at your workshop to become a lumberjack. To get out of this frozen hell and see your family once again, you must stay alive and repair your plane. Experience a unique journey each time you play with randomly generated card decks and test your survival skills while pushing your luck amidst the frozen glaciers.

entry.title: Sea of Stars
entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：$9.99 → $6.99 [$5.99 ~ $9.99]）

All Price Information

Price：$6.99

Application Description

Promising the Sabotage touch in every system, Sea of Stars aims to modernize the classic RPG formula in terms of turn-based combat, storytelling, exploration and interactions with the environment, while still offering a hearty slice of nostalgia and good old, simple fun. It tells the story of two Children of the Solstice who will combine the powers of the sun and moon to perform Eclipse Magic, the only force capable of fending off the monstrous creations of the evil alchemist known as The Fleshmancer. Traverse seamlessly through the world with a navigation system that breaks free from the classic bound-to-the-grid tileset movement and fight enemies in an immersive take on the genre; no random encounters, no transitions to separate battlefields, and no grinding. FEATURES - Engaging turn-based combat: Along with timed hits, combat features combo attacks, boosting, and a strategic "locks" system, all in an immersive take on the genre; no random encounters, no transitions to separate battlefields, and no grinding. - Full-on dynamic lighting: Our custom-made render pipeline allows the creation of a breathtaking world coming to life by pushing the limits of 2D pixel-art games. - A story-rich adventure: Sometimes epic, sometimes silly, and other times emotional, Sea of Stars does its RPG duty of exploring classic themes of adventure and friendship, while also being chock-full of the unexpected twists and events you’d expect from a Sabotage production. - A world you can touch: Sailing, cooking, fishing, stopping by a tavern to listen to a song or play the infamous tabletop game known as "Wheels"... every system has been designed to deliver an experience that pays respect to retro classics, while rethinking in some areas to offer a smooth and modernized experience. CAREFULLY REDESIGNED FOR MOBILE - Revamped interface – exclusive mobile UI with complete touch control - Game Center achievements - Cloud Save – Share your progress between iOS devices - Compatible with MFi controllers - iPhone 16 Optimization (including Pro Max) Important notice: Due to limited RAM, the following devices may not provide a stable experience and the game may not run as smoothly as intended: "iPhone Xr, iPhone SE (2nd Gen, 2020) iPad Mini (5th Gen), iPad Air (3rd Gen), iPad (8th & 9th Gen)" For the best experience, we do not recommend playing on these models.

The best interactive app for learning musculoskeletal anatomy.  AnatomyMapp® combines an empowering collection of study tools for the popular Trail Guide to the Body—a best-selling musculoskeletal anatomy textbook—into a single interactive app! It's great for not only reinforcing your textbook learning but also for studying while on the bus, having a snack, or pretty much wherever you have your phone.   AnatomyMapp® includes information from all 362 Trail Guide to the Body Flashcards; questions from the Trail Guide to the Body Student Workbook; and easy search and bookmarking capabilities: • Test your musculoskeletal anatomy knowledge by (1) answering multiple choice question (muscle cards only); (2) locating specific structures; or (3) identifying actions, origins, insertions, and nerve innervations (AOIN). • Bookmark specific cards to review later and use enhanced navigation features for bookmarked cards. • Apply the easy search function to choose all cards or only cards you’ve bookmarked. • Find additional information in the Trail Guide to the Body textbook with page references on each card. • Zoom into cards to enhance your view of the illustrations. • Learn correct pronunciation using the app’s audio pronunciation.   • Designed to be viewed in both landscape and portrait on iPad, and portrait mode on iPhone. If you have any comments or suggestions, we’d like to hear from you at info@booksofdiscovery.com.   More than 2,000 manual therapy programs have chosen Trail Guide to the Body products for their students. The textbook is sold in nearly 40 countries.   AnatomyMapp® is a registered trademark of Books of Discovery. Learn more at booksofdiscovery.com.

Enter the Aperture Science Enrichment Center and experience Bridge Constructor Portal – the unique merging of the classic Portal™ and Bridge Constructor™ games. As a new employee in the Aperture Science test lab, it's your job to build bridges, ramps, slides, and other constructions in 60 test chambers and get the Bendies safely across the finish line in their vehicles. Make use of the many Portal gadgets, like portals, propulsion gel, repulsion gel, aerial faith plates, cubes, and more to bypass the sentry turrets, acid pools and laser barriers, solve switch puzzles, and make it through the test chambers unscathed.
